rationale: Enable all ten tools so each task binds names using its own demonstrations. Task 1 binds 7 to reverse, 6 to count, 2 to minimum, and 8 to collapse consecutive duplicates; task 2 binds 1 to ascending sort, 9 to descending sort, 7 to collapse, and 4 to last; task 3 binds 7 to reverse, 6 to maximum, 4 to count, and 8 to collapse. All-positive weights preserve every supported binding for unseen tasks.
